headline: Week 6 is a bye-week squeeze with St. Brown, Jefferson and Hockenson out, so add a WR and a kicker, start Brissett over Hurts, and keep Hall on the bench until he practices.
alerts: Waivers process overnight Tuesday into Wednesday in most Sleeper leagues. Get WR, K and DEF claims in tonight.
Thu Oct 15, 5:15 PM: Seahawks at Broncos. None of your players are in this game.
No kicker shows in the tracked roster. Add one (Harrison Mevis, Rams vs. Arizona) before Sunday 10:00 AM.
Week 6 byes: Lions and Vikings. Bench St. Brown, Jefferson and Hockenson.
Sun 10:00 AM: Robinson, Downs, Hurts and Jets D lock. 1:05 PM: Brissett. 1:25 PM: Mitchell. 5:20 PM: Lloyd, Golden, Ferguson. Mon 5:15 PM: McLaurin.
Falcons flipped to 3.5-point home underdogs vs. Chicago with Michael Penix (ribs) uncertain. Optimism he plays.
Breece Hall (quad) has not practiced since Week 3. Watch the Wednesday and Thursday reports.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so free agent status is based on public roster rates. Confirm each add in the app's Waivers tab.
Week 6 player props are not posted yet. A later run will add prop numbers.

ARI.note: At Rams Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Rams -12.5, total 52.5. Arizona about 20 implied points.

PHI.note: Vs. Carolina Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Eagles -1.5, total down to 41.5, about 21.5 implied. Barkley and Smith have a shot to return, Shipley likely out for weeks.

ATL.note: Vs. Chicago Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Bears now -3.5, total 49.5, Falcons about 23 implied. Penix (ribs) trending toward playing, Tua starts if not.

LAC.note: At Kansas City Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Chiefs -8.5, total 42.5, Chargers about 17 implied. Ladd McConkey (foot) was emergency-only in Week 5.

GB.note: Vs. Dallas Sunday night 5:20 PM Pacific. Packers -1.5, total 52.5, about 27 implied. Still no timeline on Josh Jacobs.

DAL.note: At Green Bay Sunday night 5:20 PM Pacific. About 25.5 implied. CeeDee Lamb's quad bruise is not believed serious, status not confirmed.

WAS.note: At San Francisco Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. 49ers -7.5, total 50.5, Washington about 21.5 implied. Deebo Samuel (hamstring) is out for the 49ers.

IND.note: Vs. Tennessee Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Colts -6.5, total 43.5, about 25 implied.

NYJ.note: At New England Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Patriots -7.5, total 43.5, Jets about 18 implied. TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) uncertain, A.J. Brown may practice.

SEA.note: Thursday night at Denver, 5:15 PM Pacific. Seahawks -3, total 41.5. No rostered players.

DEN.note: Thursday night vs. Seattle, 5:15 PM Pacific.

Arizona is a 12.5-point underdog at the Rams with a 52.5 total, so pass volume should stay high.
Kickoff Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Kendrick Bourne is the new WR2 after the Harrison trade.
